stemMarkdown: Find the amount (in Rs.) when Rs. 26000 is invested for 1 year at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded half-yearly. (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Half-yearly compounding halves the rate and doubles the periods: 5.0% for 2 periods. $A = 26000\left(1 + \dfrac{5.0}{100}\right)^{2} = 28665.0$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Compounding more often beats annual compounding: at 10% compounded annually the amount would only be $28600.00$.
